actions.action: Open Duties, backing and fees disclosure
actions.observed:
Duties, backing and fees

S12 and S13 source behavior requires non-negative custody, not full backing of liabilities. S12 funds escrow at 110: partial(35) debits 37 and leaves 73 against duties of 75 (invoice 65, reserve 10), which is 2 short. Funding 112 would back one partial; each further partial charges another 2 that no duty reflects. That backing is a PROPOSED application policy. S12 has no extra transfer and no reserve-duty-return action; after finish, escrow holds 8 against reserve duty 10, and the nonzero reserve duty blocks V2 Close. S13 allocate(true,23,7,2) needs at least 23 A and 4 B for non-negative custody; 25 A and 10 B is PROPOSED full backing, and S13 has no action discharging allocation_reserve.

Assumptions & limits
Source-only arithmetic, not execution. The V2 Close zero-duty condition is an uncompiled-source reading.
Even under the proposed 112 policy the reserve duty stays 10 and Close stays blocked; discharge or migration needs a program change.
S13 units is checked only arithmetically (23 = 3×7 + 2) and is never debited.
A program-asset fee is not debt repayment and not a network fee. Network fees, collateral, claim-output min-ADA and the V2 thread reserve (lovelace returned on Close) are separate funding items; a reserve duty is a program liability.
Delivery evidence and dispute rules remain named assumptions. Still needs independent open/partial/finish/reserve-return accounting and a backing-policy negative.

Evidence stage: Source arithmetic reading; full backing PROPOSED

teachBack: A Web is the proposed collection of Strands a consuming contract requires for a transition; a Strand is an individual proof claim with statement and binding metadata. This page currently illustrates requirements and local arithmetic, and supplies scoped records for a narrow local invoice proof roundtrip plus finite wrapper cases. The interactive cases are illustrative: the page says general Web integration, genuine intent authorization and onchain settlement are unestablished. In the loan case, debt is shown as 100 plus 5 accrual, then 35 repayment leaves 70; the 2 fee is part of the 37 gross debit and is not debt repayment. In treasury, source minimum custody is 23 A / 4 B, while the proposed full-backing starting balance is 25 A / 10 B for newly created duties of 2 A / 6 B; creating duties does not discharge them. These quantities concern different assets and roles.
limits: This is a model persona review, not real human user research.
Used only the supplied frozen HTML and named screenshots plus the required Moriarty workflow inputs; did not inspect implementation source or other persona feedback.
One live browser viewport was used (1440×1000); supplied screenshots were visually inspected but do not establish interaction behavior.
No external links or network navigation were used.
Financial observations describe only what this page says; no financial, security, cryptographic or correctness judgment is made.
